set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123)" = "6c74532b989dd8f3a88527d1a94c65c6250ac9d3"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-prod-gsm023-qa-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "6c74532b989dd8f3a88527d1a94c65c6250ac9d3"
cd "$WORK"
echo "QA_SHA=6c74532b989dd8f3a88527d1a94c65c6250ac9d3"
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_gsm_single_transport_contract
if [[ -z "${ANDROID_HOME:-}" && -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ]]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk";export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME";fi
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleRelease :app:assembleDebug
test -s app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
test -s app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
echo "PRODUCTION_GSM_023_HOST_QA_PASS=true"
echo "QA_SHA=6c74532b989dd8f3a88527d1a94c65c6250ac9d3"
